messages:
Mike S.: Deploybot just put RC-4 on hold. vuln-scan shows one MEDIUM in libcompressors, and a licensing tag on a bundled binary that the scanner marked as unknown. holding until triage.
deploy-bot: [scan-summary] RC-4 -> status: HOLD
- vulns: libcompressors: CVE-2023-XXXX (MEDIUM, compression overflow)
- licenses: third_party/bincompressor: detected signature mismatch, license: unknown
- evidence: /artifacts/rc4/scan/1732124567/report.html

Sara L.: Ugh. release window tonight at 23:00 PT. We planned EU + NA staggered rollout. Any quick mitigation options?

Olivia (sec): MEDIUM CVE = exploitable in library when fed crafted payloads; likelihood low for our path but we should not ship without remediation plan. For license: Legal needs to confirm compatibility before redistributing.

Ben P.: Can we strip the binary and fallback to the pure-rust impl for this release? That would avoid redistribution concerns but might add +20ms p99 on compress paths. Could do a scoped build for RC-4.

Mike S.: Good idea. How fast to build/test a binary-less artifact and regen canary packages for EU only?

Ben P.: I can try a scoped build + smoke tests in ~90min if nothing blocks. Need QA sign-off for perf regression.

Sara L.: QA runway is tight. If Ben can push a build by 21:00 PT we could run a light canary in EU starting 22:00 and hold NA until metrics look stable.

Olivia (sec): From security POV, scoped build (no third-party binary) is acceptable. Also want to add runtime mitigate: enable compressor-sandboxing flag and lower connection parallelism to reduce attack surface during canary.

LegalBot: Noted. Provide the third_party/bincompressor provenance artifact and license text. If provenance missing, we cannot approve redistribution — but we can allow internal-only canary if engineering confirms artifact is removed.

Mike S.: Action items: 1) Ben - produce binary-less RC by 21:00 PT. 2) QA - light perf + integration run (Sara). 3) Olivia - confirm sandbox config. 4) Legal - confirm redistribution vs internal-only carveout and sign-off timeline.

Sara L.: I'll slot QA at 21:15 and aim to give pass/no-pass by 21:50. If pass, EU canary 22:00-00:00. If fail, rollback to RC-3 or bump change window.

deploy-bot: tip: to unhold manually (after approvals) run:
```
/deploy unhold rc-4 --by @release-oncall --reason "security carveout approved"
```
and to quarantine artifact: `/deploy quarantine rc-4 --tag rc4-1732`

Ben P.: Pushed a test branch removing bincompressor and swapped to pure-rust. Build started (ci/rc4-patch). link: https://ci.internal/runs/4592

Olivia (sec): I'll prepare the sandbox flag patch. Recommend `COMPRESS_SANDBOX=1` and `MAX_PARALLEL_COMPRESS=8` for the canary.

LegalBot: If the binary is removed from the artifact, legal can approve internal-only canary within 2 hours. Redistribution approval will need at least 48 hours for provenance checks.

Mike S.: Ok consensus: do internal-only EU canary (no redistribution) if QA passes and security sandbox enabled. Timebox: start 22:00 PT, evaluate at 23:30 PT. Rollback criteria: error rate >1% OR p99 latency increase >50% OR any crash seen in compression path.

Sara L.: I'll post metrics dashboard link in thread when canary starts and ping at evaluation. Also update release notes to mark known regression risk and that redistribution pending legal.

Ben P.: Will monitor logs and have hotfix branch ready for rolling rollback. If rollback required I'll execute `/deploy rollback rc-3 --reason "canary fail"` (with oncall).

Olivia (sec): After canary, I'll run a quick fuzz of the compression surface on canary nodes. Expect results within 30m of start.

LegalBot: Copy. internal-only canary OK. Please attach provenance artifacts for the removed binary to this thread if found; that'll accelerate redistribution approval.

Mike S.: Thanks team. Everyone please update their tasks in the release board. I'll wait for QA pass before unholding. :thumbsup:

Sara L.: QA PASS at 21:48 — smoke + perf within tolerance (p99 +12%). starting EU canary now (22:03 PT). dashboard: https://metrics/release/rc4-canary

Ben P.: Canary visible. watching logs.

Olivia (sec): fuzz running — no crashes so far (first 25m). sandbox stable.

Mike S.: Holding till 23:30 evaluation. If still green we'll keep internal EU roll and schedule redistribution approval job for legal.

Sara L.: 23:30 eval: success. no regression beyond acceptable window. recommend proceed with staged NA rollout at 02:00 PT tomorrow, but only after legal gives redistribution sign-off. cc @LegalBot

LegalBot: Redistribution approval: need provenance artifact for original bincompressor or confirmation it's fully removed. If removed, we can sign a redistribution exception and queue full rollout for 02:00 PT tomorrow. If not removed, block remains.

Mike S.: Ben, confirm artifact removed in the final build and paste the SHA.

Ben P.: Confirmed. artifact bincompressor.tar.gz NOT included. Build SHA: sha256:3a7d5f9b8c... (truncated). Attached build manifest: /artifacts/rc4/rc4-no-bin/manifest.json

LegalBot: Verified manifest. Legal sign-off complete for redistribution exception. Approved for staged rollout at 02:00 PT. Please update release notes with the follow-up remediation ticket (SEC-1427) and link to this thread.

Mike S.: Great — thanks everyone. I'll schedule the staged rollout and update the release board. Closing hold now.

deploy-bot: Action: unhold scheduled at 01:50 PT for staged rollout. Run `/deploy unhold rc-4 --by @Mike S.` when ready.
